about.title: Berkeley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Six people died on Berkeley streets in 2025, the most recent final crash count. Behind that number are households in the flats, the hills, and along the campus edges now trying to work out what comes next. If yours is one of them, we are sorry you are reading this. Berkeley's highest-volume collision corridors are I-80, University, Ashby Avenue, and Shattuck, and reported crashes tend to cluster on Fridays between 5 and 7 p.m. A wrongful death claim here is a civil matter brought in Alameda County, and it moves separately from any criminal charges the district attorney may pursue. California limits who can bring the case: a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The deadline generally runs two years from the date of death, and it is shorter when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who takes these cases on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Berkeley Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is considerably shorter when a city, county, or state agency may share fault. Starting early protects your options.

items.title: A full picture of losses
items.desc: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. Nothing is charged unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on I-80 near Berkeley. Does that change anything about the claim?
items.answer: It can. Freeways and many Berkeley streets are maintained by public agencies, and if roadway design or maintenance played any role, a claim against that agency carries a much shorter deadline than the usual two years. An attorney can evaluate quickly whether a government entity should be included so no window closes.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges in Alameda County. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs on its own track, separate from the criminal case. Your family can move forward regardless of how or when the criminal matter resolves, and the outcome of one does not decide the other.

items.question: What does it cost to be connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means no fee is owed unless there is a recovery in your case.
